proposed_fixes.title: Restore a visible Run surface on activation
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Hypothesis: activation reaches the input surface but restores invalid window geometry or fails to present the WPF surface. Cursor feedback alone does not distinguish geometry from rendering.
plan: Inspect the existing diagnostic archive for Run configuration, display geometry and rendering/startup failures; compare the two screenshots.
Instrument the Run activation/window-presentation boundary in src/modules/launcher/PowerLauncher to compare actual bounds, visibility, focus and render completion against a fresh configuration.

If invalid saved placement is confirmed, clamp/recompute placement against the active work area before showing; if bounds are valid, correct only the traced presentation failure instead. Add a regression test for the confirmed branch.
verification: Activate Run as a standard user, type abc and verify the input box and results are visible.
Repeat after auto-update, restart and display-layout changes; retain valid user placement and keyboard focus.

confidence.rationale: The public sequence is testable, but no reviewed stack or geometry measurement identifies the failing branch.

issue_context.summary: Run appears to activate after an update, but its input box and results are not visible, including while the reporter types abc.
known_information: The report names PowerToys 0.81.0 and non-administrator operation.
The maintainer requested screenshots and a bug report; the author supplied both on June 3, 2024.
The live issue is open, labeled Issue-Bug and unassigned.
inferences: The cursor change may indicate an activated input surface, but does not prove an offscreen window or graphics-driver defect.
issue_context.analysis: The prior empty-assignee ownership conclusion was unsupported. Fulfilled evidence requests put the next step on the maintainer, not the author.
initial_investigation: Read all three comments and the report.
Checked timeline cross-references and a targeted PR-body search; no concrete fix was found within that inspected scope.
Bot suggestions are similar symptoms, not verified duplicates.

actions.label: Inspect and reproduce invisible Run surface

reproduce.title: Run activation without visible input/results
reproduce.version_requirement: Compare reported 0.81.0 with a current supported build; record both versions.
prerequisites: Use the report's diagnostic configuration as a reference, without importing personal data.
steps: 1. Inspect the supplied diagnostic ZIP and both screenshots for the affected display and Run configuration.
2. Activate Run with its configured shortcut and type abc.
3. Record window bounds, focus and presentation state; compare a fresh configuration without overwriting the original.
4. Repeat on the current build to determine whether the failure remains.
reproduce.expected_result: The Run input box and query results are visible and usable; distinguish offscreen geometry from failed drawing.
